meta.title: The BOQ sheet grid: no row delete, no pagination, line numbers from the BOQ
gaps: Enable or verify the boq_in_erfx_allowed tenant gate.
Upload the required two-tab BOQ workbook: the catalog provides no BOQ workbook fixture or dedicated BOQ upload step.
Assert BOQ tabs appear at the top, the first eligible tab is automatically selected, and hidden tabs are skipped.
Compare displayed row numbers against the uploaded BOQ line numbers.
Assert there is no delete-row column, pagination, or drag-to-fill capability; no confirmed controls or structural grid assertions are supplied for these checks.
Assert product cells are plain text rather than interactive controls.
Assert each BOQ quantity displays its value and unit together.
